# CVfixaren.se
> CVfixaren.se is a free Swedish CV builder that helps job seekers create professional, ATS-optimized resumes.

## Key Pages
- [Homepage](https://www.cvfixaren.se): Create your CV for free
- [CV Templates](https://www.cvfixaren.se/cv-mallar): Browse professional CV templates
- [ATS-Optimized Templates](https://www.cvfixaren.se/ats-anpassade-cv-mallar): ATS-friendly CV templates
- [CV Examples](https://www.cvfixaren.se/cv-exempel): 50+ profession-specific CV examples
- [Cover Letter Examples](https://www.cvfixaren.se/exempel-personliga-brev): Cover letter examples by profession
- [Blog](https://www.cvfixaren.se/blogg): Career tips, interview guides, and CV advice
- [Career Tips](https://www.cvfixaren.se/karriartips): Career development guidance
- [Interview Guide](https://www.cvfixaren.se/intervjuguide): Interview preparation tips
- [FAQ](https://www.cvfixaren.se/vanliga-fragor): Common questions about the service

## Features
- Free CV creation with professional templates
- ATS-optimized formatting to pass applicant tracking systems
- PDF export
- Multiple design options (fonts, colors, layouts)
- Swedish-language interface and content

## Content Topics
- CV writing tips and best practices
- Cover letter guidance
- Job interview preparation
- Career development advice
- ATS optimization strategies
